findings.reason: the first instance is a contradiction inside §8 that would otherwise leave a second candidate-edge reader in `workers.py`, and the other two make the census incomplete so a later node misses a call site it must repoint.
findings.text: the plan rewrites the mapping claim predicate `sg.mapping_target_ids = $ids_name` to "a selected `MAPPING_CANDIDATE` edge into `$ids_name`, and no `MAPS_TO_IMAS` binding into that IDS yet", which is a candidate-edge query executed from `workers.py`, while the same section's `map-context-reads-candidates` bullet declares `read_candidates` in `imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py` the single candidate reader and asserts "No candidate query is written in `workers.py` or `mapping.py`" — the two statements are in the same section and cannot both hold; the owner to extend is `graph_ops.py` `read_candidates` (or the plan must say the claim predicate is a claim-loop predicate, not a candidate read). Also incomplete in the same census: `count_candidates_by_route` is defined twice — `imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py:653` and `imas_codex/ids/workers.py:419` — and the three importers of the `workers.py` copy are `imas_codex/cli/discover/__init__.py:84`, `:161`, `:280` (not the two sites "discover status and clear" implies), plus `imas_codex/cli/map.py:730` already imports the `graph_ops.py` copy; and the clear path has a second entry point the plan does not name, `clear_facility_candidates` at `imas_codex/cli/discover/map.py:21`, consumed at `imas_codex/cli/discover/__init__.py:288`

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design concentrates rather than spreads: one owner for DD retrieval (`retrieve_candidates`, `imas_codex/ids/candidates.py`), one owner for the `SignalSource → IMASNode` edges (`imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py`), one route count, and the claim loop delegated to `claims.py`. The new candidate reader/selector and the cross-IDS expansion sit behind small interfaces over substantial queries rather than as a layer of forwarders.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan names one duplicate (`count_candidates_by_route`) but its census of that type is incomplete, and it leaves a second candidate-edge reader in place behind a self-contradiction (instances below).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — with `public_definitions` 0, `cli_options` 0, `mcp_views` 0, `refusal_families` 0 supplied, §8 states "Public definitions stay level across §8" and names its adds (`read_candidates`, `select_candidates`) and its deletes (`count_sources_by_mapping_status`, the `workers.py` copy of `count_candidates_by_route`); §11 books each of its two added surfaces (the `Route.selected` field and the `arms` edge property) against a named retirement (the `select_margin` field and the three `mapping_target_*` SignalSource properties); §11 and §8 both refuse values through the existing `CandidateWriteError`, adding no refusal family; §9 adds no surface.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the mechanisms it extends and each was opened and confirmed to exist: `related_dd_search(gc, path, relationship_types="cluster")` (`imas_codex/graph/dd_search.py:606`, cross-IDS siblings with noise categories removed, verified at :649–665), `hybrid_dd_search` (:97) as the one DD-retrieval owner, `fetch_cross_facility_mappings` (`imas_codex/ids/tools.py:733`), `claim_batch` (`imas_codex/discovery/base/claims.py`), and `SearchHit.see_also` (`imas_codex/search/search_strategy.py:165`), whose producer-less state and existing consumer (`imas_codex/llm/search_formatters.py:1212`) the plan correctly reports.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — `read_candidates` and `select_candidates` are proposed in `graph_ops.py` with an explicit reason they cannot be `write_candidates` (write deletes and rewrites every edge; a pick must flag existing edges without disturbing the shortlist), and the plan books each retired option (--skip-metadata, --skip-errors) and field against the surface it removes.
